quest.title: Their Childhood: Good Times
quest.description: Aurele, Verut, and Lovi all seem to be playing some game again...

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: It's my turn to catch people, huh? I'll get you for sure, Lovi!

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: I wouldn't be so sure! There's some places even you can't climb up to.

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: Well, um, that's because my shoes aren't suited to climbing. If I change shoes, I can definitely get you!

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: Then let's both take our shoes off. That'll make things fair!

dialogues.speaker: Aurele
dialogues.text: Stop! You're both not allowed to run around barefoot. There's all sorts of abandoned bits and bobs everywhere. What if you get cut?

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: Okay...

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: Fine...

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: Um, brother, when you were trying to catch me earlier, you were kinda distracted, weren't you? I ran past you earlier, and you didn't respond at all.

dialogues.speaker: Aurele
dialogues.text: Huh? Did that happen? I didn't notice...

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: Exactly! I ran an entire round earlier, and you didn't seem to see me at all!

dialogues.speaker: Aurele
dialogues.text: But... Huh? It's you! Why are you here?

response.speaker: Lovi
response.text: Dad said that he needed to go out to work. Mom has to work as well.

response.speaker: Lovi
response.text: Aurele happened to come to return a book, so Dad asked him to take care of me, so I came over to play with them.

response.speaker: Aurele
response.text: Never mind that, let's continue playing. Who's going to do the catching this time?

choices.text: I thought you didn't like hide-and-seek.

response.speaker: Aurele
response.text: Well, um, *cough* I've been trying to write a review recently, and I've had some questions that need consideration.

response.speaker: Aurele
response.text: I've found that, well, my mind is more agile when I am exercising, so...

response.speaker: Lovi
response.text: But he zones out easily and sometimes just stands there talking to himself. He won't react no matter what you say to him.

response.speaker: Verut
response.text: Why don't you join us? You're way better than my brother is at hide-and-seek.

response.speaker: Verut
response.text: Hehe, go ahead and do your best. Lovi and I are masters of hide-and-seek.

response.speaker: Verut
response.text: Then let's begin. C'mon, Lovi! We've got hiding spots to find!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Lovi and Verut run like the wind, while Aurele leaves slowly, pondering as he does...

choices.text: I'm not gonna go easy on any of you.
Why the sudden enthusiasm for hide-and-seek?

response.speaker: Aurele
response.text: Yes. Mr. Delerue happens to need to go on a business trip, and Aunt Dumay also needs to work, so they asked that I take care of Lovi.

response.speaker: Aurele
response.text: So I brought her here to play with us... I hope her dress won't get too dirty...

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: So you found me anyway, huh? Guess you really are better at this.

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: I'll head back to the meeting point. I hope my brother does better...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why do you hope so?

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: Well, he did say it himself, didn't he? His brain works better after we play hide-and-seek.

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: But he has too many thoughts, and he needs to squat on the ground, trying to recall and memorize them for a long time.

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: Lovi told me that those ideas of his are very precious things, and so we shouldn't disturb him.

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: That's why when we're playing hide-and-seek with him, if we're about to catch him, we purposely take our time until he finishes collecting his thoughts.

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: It's just that if it's my brother's turn to catch people, we'll have to wait for him for a long while...

dialogues.speaker: Aurele
dialogues.text: No... This logical sequence doesn't line up. I need to come at this from a different angle...

dialogues.speaker: Aurele
dialogues.text: How about... No, no...

dialogues.speaker: Aurele
dialogues.text: Huh? Oh. You found me. I'll head back to the meeting point, then.

dialogues.speaker: Aurele
dialogues.text: Is this point of view correct? No, it... Actually, is it right or wrong...

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: I wonder if Aurele will be able to put his thoughts together...

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: Uh, what? You actually found this place? Seriously, how many times have you played hide-and-seek?

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: Well, I'll head back to the meeting point. I'll hide myself better next time!

dialogues.speaker: Aurele
dialogues.text: No, no... The argument is insufficiently rigorous here...

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: Oh well, looks like Aurele's in his own world again. Anyway, thanks for playing with us again!

response.speaker: Lovi
response.text: As long as he doesn't start drinking coffee like water, as my dad did, he should be fine.

response.speaker: Verut
response.text: Leave that one to me! I won't let my brother drink too much coffee... If it really comes down to it, I'll hide all of his coffee from him.

response.speaker: Lovi
response.text: *sigh* I was planning to hide my dad's coffee here... But I guess that's a bust.

response.speaker: Verut
response.text: It sure is tough being a reviewer...

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: You can't find me... You can't find me...

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: That Aurele, honestly...

dialogues.speaker: Aurele
dialogues.text: This passage isn't too bad...

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: You can't catch me... You can't catch me...

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: That Aurele...
